description: CRIT-002 is false for malformed storage snapshots. A snapshot whose rows_by_organ.daily value is a string passes the shallow object check, is treated as an empty row set by the core, and returns HTTP 200 with fabricated insufficient_data instead of HTTP 503 source_table_unavailable.

evidence.snippet: rows_by_organ is checked only as an object before computePanelScores; individual daily, physical, mental, and financial arrays are not validated.

resolution.notes: The API now requires rows_by_organ to contain exactly four array values; malformed storage is covered by endpoint tests and fixed matrix and returns 503 source_table_unavailable.
